## Measured

Lighthouse 12 against the live site, `https://kembar.web.id`, 2026-11-15. Performance moves a point
between runs; everything else is stable.

| | Performance | Accessibility | Best practices | SEO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile (`/`) | 97 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Mobile (`/id/`) | 99 | 100 | 100 | 100 |

Mobile LCP 2.6 s (EN) and 1.8 s (ID), CLS 0. No failing binary audits on either page.

## Live state

Working: HTTPS with a valid certificate, both locales, `_headers` applied by the Worker (assets
immutable, `nosniff`, `x-frame-options`), 404 for missing paths, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`,
canonical and `hreflang` all correct on the real domain.

Still to do:

- **`http://` does not redirect to `https://`.** Turn on Always Use HTTPS in SSL/TLS, Edge Certificates.
- **`www.kembar.web.id` does not resolve.** Add it as a second custom domain on the Worker, then a
  301 redirect rule from `www` to the apex.
- **The waitlist has not been proven end to end.** Submit your own address on the live page and
  confirm the Buttondown email arrives.
